storePageSeed.shortDescription: A tiny premium road-trip RPG with no ads, no traps, and a lot of heart.
storePageSeed.longDescription: Journey to the Parallax Pyramid is a small handcrafted retro road-trip RPG about crossing strange regions, caring for your crew, reading weird signs carefully, and arriving at the mountain together. Built as a 369 PocketGames candidate: one honest price, offline play, no ads, no gem traps, no energy timers.
featureBullets: Crew banter, camp moments, quests, badges, and local save/load
Body, mind, spirit, resources, and 369 virtue stats
Claim-safe symbolic weirdness: beautiful signs, grounded choices
Premium paid-once design with no ads or predatory in-app purchases
storePageSeed.tagline: Tiny world. Honest price. Complete fun.

releaseGates.name: First 60 Seconds Charm Gate
releaseGates.criteria: A new player understands the core action, smiles once, and trusts the no-ads/no-traps promise within the first minute.

releaseGates.name: Mobile Readability Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Text, buttons, and panels remain readable and tappable on a small phone screen.

releaseGates.name: Local Save Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Save/load works locally after closing and reopening the mobile wrapper or browser session.

releaseGates.name: $3.69 Worthiness Gate
releaseGates.criteria: A playtester can explain why the finished version feels worth the paid-once price.
